Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring funds from the budget stabilization account to the general fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transferring funds from the budget stabilizationaccount to the general fund; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state treasurer shall transfer fourhundred eight million dollars or as much as is available from thebudget stabilization account to the state general fund for fiscal year2014. (2) The state treasurer shall transfer one hundred sixtysevenmillion dollars or as much as is available from the budgetstabilization account to the state general fund for fiscal year 2015.
